Read fMRIPrep or postprocessed confound tables into clock-preserving MEDuSA nuisance and censoring inputs

Source: R/fmriprep_bids.R
read_fmriprep_confounds.Rd

Converts fMRIPrep *_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv or BrainGnomes *_desc-<desc>_confounds.tsv files (or in-memory confound data.frames) into run-matched valid_rows logical masks and finite nuisance design matrices ready for estimate_crossrun_hrf and deconvolve_crossrun_hrf. Enforces MEDuSA's clock-preservation invariant: censored volumes are marked FALSE in valid_rows rather than deleted, initial "n/a" derivative entries on volume 1 are zero-filled, and censored or missing nuisance entries are safely imputed so nuisance is strictly finite on all rows.

Usage

read_fmriprep_confounds(
  confounds,
  bold = NULL,
  run_names = NULL,
  strategy = c("24p", "6p", "12p", "24p_csf_wm", "27p", "36p", "compcor", "custom",
    "none"),
  columns = NULL,
  column_pattern = NULL,
  n_compcor = NULL,
  compcor_type = c("anatomical", "split", "temporal"),
  include_cosines = "auto",
  censor = NULL,
  fd_threshold = 0.5,
  fd_col = "auto",
  head_radius = 50,
  rot_units = c("rad", "deg"),
  dvars_threshold = NULL,
  dvars_col = "std_dvars",
  include_non_steady_state = TRUE,
  include_motion_outliers = FALSE,
  drop_initial_volumes = 0L,
  censor_prev = 0L,
  censor_next = 0L,
  min_segment_length = 1L,
  impute = c("mean", "zero"),
  impute_censored = TRUE,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE,
  drop_constant = TRUE,
  na_strings = c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", "")
)

Arguments

confounds

Character vector of confound TSV paths (*_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv, *_desc-<desc>_confounds.tsv, .tsv.gz, .csv), a single data.frame, or a list of per-run data.frames.

bold

Optional "medusa_nifti_ts" object, named list of run BOLD matrices, or single BOLD matrix used to match run ordering, validate BIDS sub-/ses-/task-/space-/cohort- entities, check BrainGnomes provenance sidecars against volume deletion, and verify exact volume counts (nrow(confounds) == nrow(bold)).

run_names

Optional explicit character vector of unique run names when bold is NULL.

strategy

Predefined nuisance regressor set:

  • "24p" (default): 6 realignment parameters (trans_x, trans_y, trans_z, rot_x, rot_y, rot_z), their temporal derivatives, and quadratic terms (Friston 24-parameter model).

  • "12p": 6 motion parameters + 6 temporal derivatives.

  • "6p": 6 rigid-body motion parameters.

  • "24p_csf_wm": "24p" + csf and white_matter with their derivatives and quadratic terms (32p physiological model without GSR).

  • "27p": "24p" + mean csf, white_matter, and global_signal without physiological derivatives or quadratics.

  • "36p": "24p_csf_wm" + global_signal with its derivative and quadratic terms (Satterthwaite 36p model).

  • "compcor": "12p" motion + top n_compcor (default 5) CompCor components + discrete cosine high-pass basis.

  • "custom": only columns requested via columns, column_pattern, and/or n_compcor.

  • "none": empty 0-column nuisance matrices (censoring only).

columns

Optional character vector of explicit confound column names, shorthand sets ("6p", "12p", "24p", "27p", "36p"), or zero-padded index range specifications such as "a_comp_cor_<0-4>" or "cosine<0,2-3>" (in addition to strategy, or exact set when strategy = "custom").

column_pattern

Optional regular expression selecting additional columns present in each confound table (e.g., "^aroma_motion_").

n_compcor

Optional integer count of leading CompCor components to add (defaults to 5L when strategy = "compcor" and 0L otherwise).

compcor_type

CompCor family when n_compcor > 0: "anatomical" (a_comp_cor_*, falling back to split c_comp_cor_* + w_comp_cor_*), "split" (c_comp_cor_* + w_comp_cor_*), or "temporal" (t_comp_cor_*).

include_cosines

Whether to include fMRIPrep discrete cosine high-pass columns (cosine00, cosine01, ...): "auto" (default; included automatically whenever CompCor columns are selected, per fMRIPrep recommendations), TRUE, or FALSE.

censor

Optional external censoring mask(s): character vector of *_censor.1D (1 = keep, 0 = censor) or *_scrub.tsv (one-hot spike indicator) paths, a logical or 0/1 vector (single run), or a list of per-run logical/0-1 vectors. When censor is supplied and fd_threshold is not explicitly set, fd_threshold defaults to NULL so the external censor mask is not overridden by a second FD cutoff.

fd_threshold

Framewise displacement censoring cutoff in mm (default 0.5; volumes with FD > fd_threshold are marked FALSE in valid_rows). Set NULL or Inf to disable FD censoring.

fd_col

Column name supplying framewise displacement, or "auto" (default), which prefers "framewise_displacement_filtered" when present (e.g., respiratory-filtered BrainGnomes postprocessing outputs), then "framewise_displacement", and falls back to computing Power (2012) FD from the 6 rigid-body motion parameters when missing or all NA.

head_radius

Head radius in mm (default 50) used when computing Power (2012) framewise displacement from the 6 rigid-body motion columns.

rot_units

Rotation parameter units ("rad" default for fMRIPrep, or "deg") used only when computing fallback Power FD.

dvars_threshold

Optional DVARS censoring cutoff (e.g., 1.5 on std_dvars). Default NULL (disabled).

dvars_col

Column name supplying DVARS when dvars_threshold is set. Default "std_dvars".

include_non_steady_state

Logical; if TRUE (default), marks any volume flagged in non_steady_state_outlier* columns as FALSE in valid_rows.

include_motion_outliers

Logical; if TRUE, also marks volumes flagged in fMRIPrep's precomputed motion_outlier* columns as FALSE in valid_rows. Default FALSE when controlled via fd_threshold/dvars_threshold.

drop_initial_volumes

Integer count of initial dummy volumes to mark FALSE in valid_rows without deleting rows (default 0L).

censor_prev

Integer count of preceding volumes to scrub before each FD/DVARS/motion-outlier spike (default 0L).

censor_next

Integer count of subsequent volumes to scrub after each FD/DVARS/motion-outlier spike (default 0L).

min_segment_length

Minimum contiguous uncensored segment length in volumes; shorter isolated islands between motion spikes are also marked FALSE (default 1L).

impute

Imputation rule for missing entries (beyond volume-1 derivative zeros) and censored rows: "mean" (usable-row column mean, default) or "zero".

impute_censored

Logical; if TRUE (default), replaces censored rows (!valid_rows) in nuisance with the imputed baseline value so motion spikes have zero leverage even if inspected or used unmasked.

center

Logical; if TRUE (default), centers each nuisance column on valid_rows.

scale

Logical; if TRUE, scales each nuisance column to unit SD on valid_rows. Default FALSE.

drop_constant

Logical; if TRUE (default), removes columns with near-zero variance on valid_rows (such as all-zero outlier columns).

na_strings

Character vector of missing-value tokens passed to data.table::fread. Default c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", "").

Value

An S3 list of class "medusa_confounds" containing:

  • nuisance: Run-named list of finite numeric T x P matrices.

  • valid_rows: Run-named list of length-T logical observation masks (TRUE = usable, FALSE = censored).

  • summary: Per-run QC data.frame reporting volume counts, censored counts/percentages, outlier breakdowns, mean/max FD, and retained nuisance column counts.

  • framewise_displacement: Run-named list of numeric FD vectors.

The "medusa_confounds" object can be passed directly as nuisance = conf to estimate_crossrun_hrf (automatically supplying both nuisance and valid_rows) or as valid = conf to align_medusa_ts.

See also

read_bids_events, read_fmriprep_subject, read_nifti_ts, estimate_crossrun_hrf

Examples

f_conf <- tempfile("sub-01_task-mid_run-01_", fileext = "_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv")
conf_df <- data.frame(
  trans_x = c(0.01, 0.02, 0.40, 0.03, 0.02),
  trans_y = c(0.00, -0.01, 0.25, 0.01, 0.00),
  trans_z = c(0.02, 0.03, 0.80, 0.04, 0.03),
  rot_x = c(0.001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.002, 0.001),
  rot_y = c(0.000, 0.001, 0.005, 0.001, 0.001),
  rot_z = c(-0.001, 0.000, 0.004, 0.000, -0.001),
  framewise_displacement = c("n/a", "0.08", "0.92", "0.12", "0.05"),
  non_steady_state_outlier00 = c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(conf_df, f_conf, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

conf <- read_fmriprep_confounds(f_conf, strategy = "12p", fd_threshold = 0.5)
conf$valid_rows$run1
#> [1] FALSE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE  TRUE
conf$summary
#>    run
#> 1 run1
#>                                                                                file
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpKuc1cx/sub-01_task-mid_run-01_190d2ecdaf8f_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv
#>   n_volumes n_valid n_censored pct_censored n_fd_outliers n_dvars_outliers
#> 1         5       3          2           40             1                0
#>   n_non_steady_state n_external_censor mean_fd max_fd n_nuisance_cols
#> 1                  1                 0  0.2925   0.92              11
unlink(f_conf)
